capabilities: Keeps the display awake while Obsidian is in the foreground
Applies activation strategies: always on, frontmatter, editor focus, editor typing
Toggles the wake lock via hotkey, command palette or status bar
Shows the wake lock state in the status bar
Configures notifications and a developer mode
disambiguation: Not a recipe or cooking-notes plugin; it only stops the display from sleeping.
extras: On iOS before 18.4 the wake lock may need the plugin toggled off and on to activate; also installable as a beta plugin through BRAT.
problem: The screen dims or locks during long reading, writing or cooking sessions in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT from the Community Plugins in Obsidian.

summary: Plugin that keeps the screen awake while Obsidian is in the foreground, with several selectable activation strategies.
